subject.title: Memory MVP: add ingestion helpers and CLI/skill surface

question: Should OpenClaw standardize a first-class remember/recall/review/edit/forget memory facade in the default memory plugin now, route this to ClawHub/plugin packages first, or wait until the companion schema, provenance, write-path, and lifecycle trackers converge?
rationale: The requested gap is real, but the implementation would define durable memory lifecycle semantics, operator UX, provenance requirements, and memory plugin API shape rather than repair one broken current behavior.

options.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker while schema, provenance, write-resolution, and review/edit/forget contracts are settled, then build the smallest default facade.

options.title: Route To Plugin First
options.body: Ask for a ClawHub skill, plugin, or external memory package first unless maintainers identify a missing SDK seam that core must add.

options.title: Fold Into Companion Trackers
options.body: Close or narrow this only if maintainers decide the facade should be fully decomposed into the open schema, provenance, write-path, lifecycle, and chunking/entity issues.

recommendation.title: Keep As MVP Design Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the operator-surface tracker while schema, provenance, write-resolution, and review/edit/forget contracts are settled, then build the smallest default facade.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent memory storage, SDK, schema, and Memory Wiki history makes this the best available routing candidate for the lifecycle contract decision.
